style.name: Glassmorphism
style.tagline: A little depth. A lot of light.
style.description: Glassmorphism simulates translucent surfaces using background blur, subtle borders, and layered color. Its effect depends on a visible scene behind each panel, creating depth without the weight of opaque containers.

fonts.heading: Inter
fonts.rationale: A restrained sans keeps the layered material treatment in focus and supports dense controls.

tips: Provide an opaque fallback for blur.
Check text contrast against every background.
avoid: Placing small text over unpredictable imagery.
Depending on transparency to indicate state.

recipe.composition: Layer a few translucent panels above a visible scene; keep text on a reliable reading surface.
recipe.motion: Short opacity and position changes describe depth; provide solid surfaces when transparency is reduced.
recipe.signature: Frosted layers, restrained highlights, and a scene that remains visible behind them.
